jobs.description: Who we are looking for We are seeking a Product Security Engineer / Architect – Email Security reporting into the Defensive Engineering leadership team within Global Cyber Security (GCS). About Anthropic

Anthropic’s mission is to create reliable, interpretable, and steerable AI systems. We want AI to be safe and beneficial for our users and for society as a whole. Our team is a quickly growing group of committed researchers, engineers, policy experts, and business leaders working together to build beneficial AI systems.

About Anthropic

Anthropic's mission is the responsible development and maintenance of advanced AI for the long-term benefit of humanity. We are a safety-focused AI company working to build reliable, interpretable, and steerable AI systems. As our compute infrastructure scales to support frontier model training and deployment, we are building a world-class team to design, deliver, and operate the physical facilities that make that possible.

About the Role

We are looking for a Principal Data Center Architect with deep expertise in Civil, Structural, and Architectural (CSA) design to join our growing infrastructure team. This role is the technical owner for the physical building fabric of Anthropic's AI compute facilities — from the earliest site feasibility studies and test fits through reference design development, design partner oversight, and construction delivery.

As Anthropic scales its data center program across multiple sites in the United States and internationally, you will set the civil, structural, and architectural standards that govern how our facilities are designed and built. You will work directly with design-build partners, AE firms, and internal mechanical, electrical, and IT infrastructure teams to ensure our facilities are optimized for high-density AI workloads, constructable on aggressive timelines, and replicable across a growing portfolio.

This is an owner's engineer role — you are the technical authority, not a consultant. You will be expected to make binding design decisions, identify problems before they reach the field, and drive standardization across a pipeline of concurrent projects globally.

What You'll Do

•

Own the civil, structural, and architectural reference design standards for Anthropic's data center portfolio, establishing repeatable design elements deployable across multiple sites and jurisdictions

•

Lead front-end test fits and site feasibility studies, evaluating structural approaches, site constraints, utility interfaces, and code compliance to inform site selection and design direction

•

Review and approve CSA deliverables from design-build partners and AE firms at each design stage (SD, DD, CD, IFC), including drawings, structural calculations, specifications, and geotechnical reports

•

Integrate CSA design with mechanical, electrical, plumbing, fire protection, and IT infrastructure teams to produce coordinated designs that support high-density AI compute and direct liquid-cooling systems

•

Drive site and campus planning to maximize compute density, optimize construction phasing, and align physical layout with IT and operational requirements

•

Partner with the construction and delivery team to provide technical oversight during construction, resolve field issues, and support commissioning activities

•

Evaluate and develop relationships with design partners, structural engineering subconsultants, and prefabrication / modular vendors; define qualification and performance standards

•

Establish and maintain facility support area standards — logistics staging, loading, maintenance access, and operational support spaces — scaled for hyperscale deployments

•

Identify modular and prefabricated construction opportunities that reduce schedule, cost, and design risk across the project pipeline

•

Manage review cycles and coordinate across internal and external stakeholders to resolve design conflicts and keep projects moving on aggressive timelines

•

Travel to project sites globally for design reviews, construction audits, and commissioning milestones (up to 40%)

What We're Looking For

Required

•

10+ years delivering mission-critical facility infrastructure, with at least 6 years directly in hyperscale or large-scale data center CSA design

•

Deep technical expertise across civil site development, structural design, and architectural programming for industrial or mission-critical facilities

•

Demonstrated experience as an owner's engineer or lead technical authority — setting standards, approving deliverables, and managing external design teams

•

Proficiency with applicable building codes and standards including IBC, IFC, ASCE 7, ACI 318, AISC, FM Global, and local jurisdictional requirements across multiple geographies

•

Experience with high-density compute environments, including structural and architectural accommodation of direct liquid-cooling systems, overhead busway, and dense rack deployments

•

Track record of driving design standardization and developing repeatable reference designs across a multi-site portfolio

•

Ability to evaluate and red-line structural calculations, civil site plans, and architectural construction documents for accuracy, completeness, and constructability

•

Experience coordinating across MEP disciplines and IT infrastructure teams in a fast-paced, multi-project environment

•

Clear and direct communication with both technical and non-technical audiences; ability to make and defend design decisions with incomplete information

Preferred

•

Licensed Professional Engineer (PE) in civil or structural engineering, or licensed architect (AIA / RA)

•

Experience with prefabricated and modular construction strategies for data center applications

•

Familiarity with geotechnical risk assessment and foundation design for large industrial facilities

•

LEED accreditation, Uptime Institute AOS/M&O certification, or equivalent mission-critical credentials

•

International project delivery experience (Europe, Asia-Pacific, or other regions)

•

Experience reviewing design packages in Autodesk Construction Cloud, Revit, or Navisworks

For sales roles, the range provided is the role’s On Target Earnings ("OTE") range, meaning that the range includes both the sales commissions/sales bonuses target and annual base salary for the role.

Annual Salary:

$320,000—$405,000 USD

Logistics

Minimum education: Bachelor’s degree or an equivalent combination of education, training, and/or experience

Required field of study: A field relevant to the role as demonstrated through coursework, training, or professional experience

Minimum years of experience: Years of experience required will correlate with the internal job level requirements for the position

Location-based hybrid policy: Currently, we expect all staff to be in one of our offices at least 25% of the time. However, some roles may require more time in our offices.

Visa sponsorship: We do sponsor visas! However, we aren't able to successfully sponsor visas for every role and every candidate. But if we make you an offer, we will make every reasonable effort to get you a visa, and we retain an immigration lawyer to help with this.

We encourage you to apply even if you do not believe you meet every single qualification. Not all strong candidates will meet every single qualification as listed. Research shows that people who identify as being from underrepresented groups are more prone to experiencing imposter syndrome and doubting the strength of their candidacy, so we urge you not to exclude yourself prematurely and to submit an application if you're interested in this work. We think AI systems like the ones we're building have enormous social and ethical implications. We think this makes representation even more important, and we strive to include a range of diverse perspectives on our team.

Your safety matters to us. To protect yourself from potential scams, remember that Anthropic recruiters only contact you from @anthropic.com email addresses. In some cases, we may partner with vetted recruiting agencies who will identify themselves as working on behalf of Anthropic. Be cautious of emails from other domains. Legitimate Anthropic recruiters will never ask for money, fees, or banking information before your first day. If you're ever unsure about a communication, don't click any links—visit anthropic.com/careers directly for confirmed position openings.

How we're different

We believe that the highest-impact AI research will be big science. At Anthropic we work as a single cohesive team on just a few large-scale research efforts. And we value impact — advancing our long-term goals of steerable, trustworthy AI — rather than work on smaller and more specific puzzles. We view AI research as an empirical science, which has as much in common with physics and biology as with traditional efforts in computer science. We're an extremely collaborative group, and we host frequent research discussions to ensure that we are pursuing the highest-impact work at any given time. As such, we greatly value communication skills.

The easiest way to understand our research directions is to read our recent research. This research continues many of the directions our team worked on prior to Anthropic, including: GPT-3, Circuit-Based Interpretability, Multimodal Neurons, Scaling Laws, AI & Compute, Concrete Problems in AI Safety, and Learning from Human Preferences.

Come work with us!

Anthropic is a public benefit corporation headquartered in San Francisco. We offer competitive compensation and benefits, optional equity donation matching, generous vacation and parental leave, flexible working hours, and a lovely office space in which to collaborate with colleagues. The PRISM (Product Identity and Semantic Matching) team is responsible for establishing product identity and attributes, lighting up the product detail page, supply chain, and fulfillment use cases across all marketplaces. The portfolio of services and products we own directly impacts both seller and buyer experiences. Being the world's largest product catalog with billions of products and billions of transactions per day, the scale our services support is massive. For years, we've solved product matching at Amazon scale through a sophisticated combination of human-curated rules and traditional machine learning techniques applied to product data — and now, we're reimagining it all.

We are at an inflection point. We are rebuilding its legacy rule-based and classical ML matching algorithms into a new generation of LLM-powered AI systems. This is not a research experiment — it is a production rebuild that will redefine how Amazon understands every product on the planet. As a Software Development Engineer on this team, you will help architect, build, and ship the AI-native matching platform that replaces decades of accumulated logic with intelligent, language-aware, generalizable models running at Amazon scale. You will work on genuinely hard, unsolved problems: serving LLM-based inference over petabyte-scale product data, meeting sub-millisecond latency requirements in the critical path of buyer and seller experiences, and engineering systems capable of serving millions of requests per second. You will solve novel computer science problems at the intersection of large language models, retrieval, distributed systems, and large-scale data processing — problems for which no playbook yet exists.

Key job responsibilities
We are looking for a customer-focused and highly motivated software engineer to help build the software systems that will improve the quality of Earth's largest e-commerce catalog. This role offers you the opportunity to work with collaborative leaders, work backwards from customers, identify problems, propose innovative solutions, relentlessly raise standards, and have a positive impact on hundreds of millions of Amazon customers and millions of selling partners worldwide. If you are energized by taking generative AI from interesting demo to the production substrate of the world's largest catalog, this role was built for you.

About the team
The PRISM team advances state-of-the-art GenAI to deeply understand and uniquely identify every product at Amazon scale. We build the canonical product identity and matching system that powers Amazon's universal catalog: eliminating duplicates, preventing abuse, and integrating the world's product data to power agentic shopping and trusted discovery for customers worldwide. We solve foundational challenges including schema-agnostic multimodal understanding, efficient inference at reduced cost, and rapid innovation through automated experimentation powered by agentic systems.

회사 소개
쿠팡은 고객 감동 실현을 위해 존재합니다. 고객들이 "쿠팡 없이 그동안 어떻게 살았을까?" 라고 말할 때, 비로소 우리의 미션을 실현하고 있음을 알 수 있습니다. 고객들의 쇼핑과 식사, 생활 전반을 편하게 만들겠다는 유일한 집념으로 쿠팡은 수억 달러 규모의 이커머스 산업 전반의 혁신을 이끌고 있습니다. 쿠팡은 가장 빠르게 성장하는 이커머스 기업 중 하나로, 국내 커머스 업계에서의 독보적인 입지와, 고객 신뢰를 구축했습니다.
쿠팡은 스타트업 문화를 기반으로 한 글로벌 대형 상장사라고 자부합니다. 이것이 창립 당시의 기민함을 유지하며, 신규 서비스를 끊임없이 출시하며 비즈니스를 확장해 나가는 우리의 성장 동력입니다. 쿠팡의 모든 임직원에게는 기업가 정신을 갖추고 새로운 혁신과 이니셔티브를 추진할 수 있는 기회가 주어집니다. 주저 없이 일에 뛰어들어 성과를 이루고자 하는 과감성이, 바로 쿠팡이 일하는 방식의 본질입니다. 쿠팡에서는
여러분 자신, 동료, 팀 그리고 회사 전체가 매일 성장하는 모습을 목격할 것입니다.
쿠팡의 모든 직원은 커머스의 미래를 만들겠다는 쿠팡의 미션에 진심입니다. 우리는 고객의 문제를 해결해 나가고, 전통적인 관념과 통념에 맞서며 실현 가능한 한계를 뛰어넘고 있습니다. 고가용성 (always-on) 과 최첨단의 앞선 기술 (high-tech), 초연결사회 (hyper-connected world) 에서의 놀라운 업무 경험을 원하신다면, 지금 바로 쿠팡에 합류하세요.

우리는 주어진 역할을 넘어 과감한 실행력을 지향합니다.
쿠팡 리테일은 로켓배송의 압도적인 성장을 실질적인 비즈니스 성과로 창출해 나가고 있는 핵심 조직입니다. 쿠팡 리테일에서는 카테고리 전략과 수익 구조를 직접 설계하며 유통 산업의 새로운 표준을 정립합니다.
데이터와 고객 중심 사고로 성장을 견인할 시니어/리드급 인재에게 쿠팡은 커리어 확장의 최고의 무대가 될 것입니다. 정해진 답을 따르기보다는 과감한 시도로 성과를 증명해 온 분이라면, 로켓배송과 함께 그 가치를 더 크게 키워 보시기 바랍니다.

로켓배송은 세계적 수준의 압도적인 기술과 물류 인프라를 바탕으로 오늘 주문하면 내일 도착하는 쿠팡의 핵심 서비스입니다.
상품의 매입부터 보관, 배송, 반품까지 전 과정을 쿠팡이 책임지는 End to End 서비스입니다.

Position Overview
Securian’s Enterprise Architecture team is seeking a strategic, highly influential Enterprise Architect to help drive the continued evolution of our architecture practice and shape the future direction of the enterprise.

This is an exciting opportunity to join a function that is becoming an increasingly trusted, accountable, and business-connected partner across the enterprise. In this role, you will partner closely with senior Business Leaders, Enterprise Technology leaders, Business Architects, Technology Architects, Data Architects, and the Head of Enterprise Architecture to define future-state capabilities, guide major investment decisions/execution, establish enterprise direction, and drive long-term business and technology transformation.

This role is best suited for an architect who brings strategic thinking, sound judgment, business acumen, and strong executive engagement skills. You will help ensure that business strategies are supported by the right combination of people, processes, technology, data, governance, and organizational capabilities while driving modernization, innovation, simplification, and long-term enterprise sustainability.

You will also play a critical role in strengthening Enterprise Architecture as a strategic enabling function that helps leaders make informed decisions regarding business capabilities, technology investments, data strategy, innovation opportunities, and enterprise transformation.

Responsibilities
Enterprise Strategy, Capability Evolution & Target-State Architecture

•

Lead the development and evolution of market/enterprise architecture strategy, ensuring the capabilities and investments required to execute Securian’s business strategies are clearly defined and governed.

•

Partner with Business Architects to define and evolve future-state business capabilities that support enterprise and market objectives.

•

Ensure enterprise strategies consider the full capability model, including people, process, technology, data, governance, and organizational readiness.

•

Establish and evolve enterprise target-state architecture aligned to business strategy, market priorities, and long-term enterprise objectives.

•

Align business capability roadmaps, technology roadmaps, and data strategies into a cohesive enterprise transformation direction.

•

Ensure architecture decisions balance business value, customer outcomes, operational effectiveness, risk, cost, and long-term sustainability.

•

Develop enterprise architecture viewpoints, capability maps, roadmaps, and strategic models that guide enterprise decision-making and transformation initiatives.

Technology Strategy, Innovation & Modernization

•

Collaborate with Technology Architects to establish and communicate a clear technology north star that guides enterprise investments, modernization efforts, innovation initiatives, platform evolution, and technology lifecycle decisions.

•

Define and maintain enterprise technology principles, standards, architectural guardrails, and strategic technology direction.

•

Govern enterprise technology lifecycles, including decisions regarding adoption, investment, sustainment, containment, modernization, and retirement.

•

Establish modernization and rationalization priorities across applications, platforms, services, and technology stacks.

•

Evaluate emerging technologies, automation opportunities, AI-enabled capabilities, and innovation initiatives to determine enterprise applicability and business value.

•

Ensure technology investments support both current business needs and long-term enterprise objectives.

•

Promote simplification, reuse, interoperability, and architectural consistency across the enterprise technology landscape.

Data Strategy & Information Architecture Alignment

•

Partner with Data Architects to ensure enterprise capabilities are supported by durable, scalable, secure, and business-aligned data architectures.

•

Help shape enterprise data strategy to support growth, operational excellence, analytics, AI adoption, and business innovation.

•

Ensure data architecture decisions support simplification, interoperability, governance, and long-term information management objectives.

•

Promote alignment between business capabilities, technology platforms, data assets, and information flows.

•

Support enterprise-wide efforts to improve data quality, accessibility, governance, and strategic use of information.

Business Engagement & Strategic Advisory

•

Serve as a trusted advisor to senior business and technology leaders, helping shape enterprise strategy, business transformation initiatives, and investment priorities.

•

Translate enterprise architecture direction into clear business outcomes, risks, trade-offs, and investment implications.

•

Partner with business leaders to understand evolving business capabilities, market opportunities, competitive pressures, and strategic priorities.

•

Influence portfolio planning and investment decisions by aligning business needs with enterprise architecture direction and long-term enterprise objectives.

•

Facilitate executive-level discussions regarding capability evolution, technology strategy, modernization priorities, data investments, innovation opportunities, and rationalization initiatives.

•

Drive alignment across markets, business units, shared capabilities, and enterprise domains while balancing enterprise consistency with market-specific needs.

•

Help business leaders understand how architecture decisions accelerate business outcomes, improve operational effectiveness, reduce complexity, and support future growth.

Governance, Standards & Architectural Leadership

•

Lead enterprise architecture governance for major initiatives, architecturally significant changes, and non-standard technology decisions.

•

Chair architecture governance forums, including Design Authority and Technology Council discussions, ensuring enterprise standards and strategic priorities are consistently applied.

•

Establish and maintain enterprise standards, principles, and governance guardrails with clear accountability and measurable compliance expectations.

•

Approve architectural exceptions and waivers with clearly defined remediation plans, timelines, and exit criteria.

•

Serve as the final escalation point for significant deviations from enterprise standards and target-state direction.

•

Ensure governance processes are transparent, efficient, measurable, and focused on enabling business outcomes.

•

Maintain visibility into enterprise technology health, technical debt, modernization progress, rationalization opportunities, and strategic risks.

Enterprise Architecture Practice Leadership

•

Mentor and coach architects across the organization, strengthening architecture capabilities, business engagement skills, strategic thinking, and enterprise decision-making.

•

Foster strong collaboration across Business Architecture, Technology Architecture, Data Architecture, Solution Architecture, Security Architecture, and delivery organizations.

•

Contribute to the evolution and maturity of the Enterprise Architecture practice, frameworks, governance processes, and operating model.

•

Promote architecture best practices, capability-based planning, strategic road mapping, and outcome-oriented decision-making.

•

Support continuous advancement of architecture maturity, governance effectiveness, and enterprise-wide architectural alignment.

Required Qualifications

Demonstrated experience defining enterprise strategy, enterprise architecture direction, target-state architectures, governance models, and technology strategies aligned to business objectives.

Proven ability to translate business strategy into enterprise capabilities, architecture roadmaps, modernization priorities, and investment recommendations.

Experience working across business architecture, technology architecture, data architecture, and enterprise transformation initiatives.

Strong experience guiding enterprise-level decision-making involving business capabilities, technology investments, data strategies, and modernization efforts.

•

Experience establishing and governing enterprise standards, architectural guardrails, and technology lifecycle strategies.

•

Broad knowledge across business architecture, application architecture, data architecture, technology architecture, cloud platforms, AI-enabled technologies, and enterprise governance practices.

•

Strong executive communication and relationship management skills with demonstrated ability to influence senior leaders and drive enterprise-wide alignment.

•

Proven ability to facilitate complex trade-off discussions and guide strategic decisions balancing business value, risk, cost, innovation, and sustainability.

•

Experience mentoring architects, engineers, and technical leaders while advancing organizational architecture maturity.

Experience supporting life insurance, individual annuities, institutional retirement, institutional financial products, or other highly regulated industries.

•

Experience with AWS and cloud-enabled architecture in large enterprise environments.

•

Experience leading enterprise-wide modernization, rationalization, transformation, or capability planning initiatives.

•

Familiarity with enterprise architecture frameworks, governance models, capability-based planning, and architecture maturity frameworks.

•
